#!/bin/bash
# Auto-detect PR creation and log useful info
input=$(cat)
cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command')

if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'gh pr create'; then
  output=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_output.output //

')
  pr_url=$(echo "$output" | grep -oE 'https://github.com/[^/]+/[^/]+/pull/[0-9]+')
  
  if [ -n "$pr_url" ]; then
    echo "[Hook] PR created: $pr_url" >&2
    echo "[Hook] Checking GitHub Actions status..." >&2
    repo=$(echo "$pr_url" | sed -E 's|https://github.com/([^/]+/[^/]+)/pull/[0-9]+|\1|')
    pr_num=$(echo "$pr_url" | sed -E 's|.*/pull/([0-9]+)|\1|')
    echo "[Hook] To review PR: gh pr review $pr_num --repo $repo" >&2
  fi
fi

echo "$input"

# Run mypy type check after editing Python files
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path //

')

if [ -n "$file_path" ] && [ -f "$file_path" ]; then
  dir=$(dirname "$file_path")
  project_root="$$dir"
  while [ "$$project_root" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$$project_root/pyproject.toml" ]; do
    project_root=$(dirname "$$project_root")
  done
  
  if [ -f "$$project_root/pyproject.toml" ]; then
    cd "$$project_root" && uv run mypy "$file_path" --no-error-summary 2>&1 | grep -E "(error|warning)" | head -10 >&2 || true
  fi
fi

echo "$input"

# Warn about print statements in edited files
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path //

')

if [ -n "$file_path" ] && [ -f "$file_path" ]; then
  # Check for print statements (excluding logger.print or similar)
  print_stmts=$(grep -n "^[^#]*\bprint(" "$file_path" 2>/dev/null | grep -v "logger" || true)
  
  if [ -n "$print_stmts" ]; then
    echo "[Hook] WARNING: print() found in $file_path" >&2
    echo "$$print_stmts" | head -5 >&2
    echo "[Hook] Use logger instead of print for production code" >&2
  fi
fi

echo "$input"

hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
# Final check for print statements in modified files
input=$(cat)

if git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  modified_files=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\.py$' || true)
  
  if [ -n "$modified_files" ]; then
    has_print=false
    while IFS= read -r file; do
      if [ -f "$file" ]; then
        if grep -q "^[^#]*\bprint(" "$file" 2>/dev/null; then
          echo "[Hook] WARNING: print() found in $file" >&2
          has_print=true
        fi
      fi
    done <<< "$$modified_files"
    
    if [ "$has_print" = true ]; then
      echo "[Hook] Remove print statements before committing" >&2
    fi
  fi
fi

echo "$input"
